description:
Query cell metadata and save to parquet file.
Data: CZ CELLxGENE Census (human) · table obs — one record = one cell in one dataset.
Key: soma_joinid.
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.donor` counts donors; `_vbt.grains.dataset` counts datasets; `_vbt.grains.cell_type` counts cell_types; `_vbt.grains.tissue` counts tissues.
is_primary_data: NOT applied by this tool; such rows are included.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Cells of the human Census release named in the result; absence means not in the Census, not absent from the tissue.

include_duplicates.description: Include duplicate records (cells counted in several datasets), which are excluded by default; their number is disclosed.

value_filter.description: Matched by the source's search engine: SOMA value_filter over obs columns (==, !=, in, and, or); parsed by the gateway.
